properties.name: Griffin-1
properties.note: Target published as 'Mons Mouton / Nobile' (catalogue lists Griffin-1 among the Mons Mouton arrivals); point at the Mons Mouton gazetteer centre.

properties.name: IM-3
properties.note: Catalogue coordinate ~7.4°N, 59.0°W (Reiner Gamma swirl).

properties.name: Blue Moon MK1
properties.note: Only the latitude (~89.5°S) is published for the Shackleton connecting ridge; point at the Shackleton crater gazetteer centre, not the landing site.

properties.name: IM-4
properties.note: Point at the Mons Mouton gazetteer centre; the landing site within the massif is not published.

properties.name: Blue Ghost M2
properties.note: Landing site published only as 'far side'; no point.

properties.name: Blue Moon + VIPER
properties.note: VIPER revived Sep 2025 on Blue Moon; point at the Mons Mouton gazetteer centre.

properties.name: Chang'e-7
properties.note: Catalogue coordinate ~88.8°S, 123.4°E is unofficial (Aug 2026 launch scrubbed, now 2027).

properties.name: Chandrayaan-4
properties.note: Published only as 'near the Chandrayaan-3 landing site'; point at the LROC position of the Chandrayaan-3 Vikram lander (Statio Shiv Shakti).

properties.name: Artemis IV / V
properties.note: First crewed landing is Artemis IV (2028), lander not assigned; the candidate regions are the artemis_region features in this layer.

properties.name: Blue Ghost M3
properties.note: 'Gruithuisen Domes' is not an IAU name; point at the midpoint of the gazetteer centres of Mons Gruithuisen Gamma and Mons Gruithuisen Delta.

properties.name: PROMISE rover
properties.note: Target published only as south-pole permanently shadowed regions; no point.

properties.name: LUPEX
properties.note: Landing site not published; no point.

properties.name: Chang'e-8
properties.note: 'Leibnitz Beta' is the informal name of the massif the IAU named Mons Mouton; point at its gazetteer centre.

properties.name: Lanyue (China crewed)
properties.note: Landing site not announced (Rimae Bode is an academic proposal only); no point.

properties.name: Fission Surface Power
properties.note: No point.

properties.name: ILRS
properties.note: No site published; no point.
